details: Enhancing the functionality of VRChat's status system by incorporating an opt-in feature could significantly streamline user experiences and interactions within the platform. Offering users the ability to automate friend removal based on various criteria, such as time since the last interaction or customizable filters like whitelist and rank-based preferences, would revolutionize friend list management. This feature would alleviate the burden of manual friend purging, particularly beneficial for those seeking a more streamlined and clutter-free experience. By enabling users to set parameters for automatic friend removal, like the duration since their last interaction or the option to filter friends based on specific ranks, it empowers individuals to maintain a more curated friend list. This innovation could effectively mitigate congestion caused by random join requests and alleviate concerns about privacy or unwanted interactions. Ultimately, this opt-in feature could enhance user control and enjoyment of VRChat, fostering a more personalized and efficient social experience.
title: Streamlining Social Interactions: Introducing Enhanced Friend Management in VRChat
